transcript: Speaker A: I don't think enough people know about this productivity hack and I want to put you on because this saved me 8 hours alone last week. Check this out. So I literally stopped using my keyboard and instead hold the function button. Brain dump prompt. Send my affiliate link. Send follow-up email. So these are all shortcuts and snippets that I saved inside of Whisper Flow. Now all I have to do is speak a keyword and I get a templated response. That saves me at least 5 hours a week of stuff that I used to be typing. I don't know why you wouldn't download Whisper Flow because you can try it for free.
on_screen_text: Bruh...HALF of the Fortune 500 companies threw away their keyboards to use this productivity tool 🤫
summary: The presenter demonstrates Whisper Flow, a tool that replaces typing with voice-activated text snippets. He shows how it saves him hours of work on his laptop. The video ends with a call to try the tool for free.
